newsitem.title: ESTONIA: LEKS' 1996 ASSETS REACH 66.3 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: LEKS' 1996 ASSETS REACH 66.3 MLN KROONS.

text.p: The assets of Leks Insurance, which is seeking a stock market listing, rose in 1996 to 66.4 million kroons from 1995's 25.3 million kroons, the company said on Monday.
One of the biggest increases was in the company's invesments into property and real estate, it said in a statement.
Newspaper Aripaev earlier reported that issue price of Leks' shares will be 38 kroons a share as it aims for a listing on the secondary market of the exchange.
Leks said 1996 investment into construction and real estate rose to 13 million kroons compared to no investment in 1995.
The company also increased investment into its subsidiary life insurance arm with 18.9 million kroons invested in 1996 compared to 3.8 million kroons invested in 1995.
On the company's liabilities, its share capital saw the biggest increase in 1996 with 38 million kroons in 1996 compared to nine million kroons in 1995.
Leks Insurance is partly owned by Tallinna Pank Huvitus Fund and investment bank Talinvest and private share holders.
